briefing.summary: You've just been issued your IFR clearance. Read it back.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Lima Echo Foxtrot, cleared to Coffs Harbour via flight planned route, climb to seven thousand, squawk four one two three.

challenge.prompt: Read back the clearance Bankstown just issued.
challenge.expectedText: Cleared to Coffs Harbour via flight planned route, climb to seven thousand, squawk four one two three, Lima Echo Foxtrot.

elements.label: Callsign at end
elements.hint: Australian convention: callsign at the END of a readback, not the start.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 + MATS Part 4: mandatory readback of clearance limit, route, altitude/level assignment, and squawk. Callsign closes the transmission.
